rationale: TNT Plumbing & Drainage Site Engineer (Site Administration), Newcastle: document control, RFIs, ITPs, site diaries, procurement tracking and handover records for Tier 1 builder projects.
Accepts a qualification in engineering or relevant experience; White Card and driver's licence required, both held.
Marc's Philippines site work (site reports, material records, procurement tracking, quality checks, drawing reviews) maps to most duties.
caution: Advert asks for experience with Tier 1 builders and their documentation requirements, which Marc does not have; plumbing and drainage background highly regarded but Marc has not worked on water or sewer projects. Newcastle relocation to discuss.
gaps: No commercial plumbing and drainage experience
Has not used HammerTech, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud or Project Simpel
employer_line: TNT Plumbing & Drainage, a family company on the Central Coast since 2006, lists work including the Sydney Water Galston Gorge sewer upgrade and a pre-qualified RailCorp NSW plumbing panel.
title: Site Engineer – Site Administration
screening_questions: How many years' experience do you have as a Site Administrator?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
